note: OCG Standard §25 ocg-private-input@1. policy_parameters carries ONLY the two sha256-salted@1 commitments (income, debts) plus public dti_max_bps/unit/as_of/citation, never an income or debt amount. All figures are synthetic. Disclosure material lives OUT-OF-BAND in art-811-check-dti-within-policy-private.disclosure.json (test-only). human_sign_off: PENDING.

vectors.name: moderate_debts_within_4300
vectors.description: Three monthly obligations of 1,500.00 total 4,500.00 against 12,000.00 income at 4300 bps (ratio 3750 bps). Within policy.

policy_parameters.citation: 12 CFR 1026.51(a)(1)(ii): a card issuer's reasonable written policies and procedures must consider the ratio of debt obligations to income, and it is unreasonable to issue a card to a consumer who has no income or assets. The regulation names no ratio; the threshold is the issuer's own policy.

output_payload.basis: Shows that the committed monthly debt obligations are at most the chosen share of the committed monthly income. The share comes from a fixed list. It does not show that every debt was listed or that the income is real.
output_payload.privacy_note: The verdict is public. The inputs are not in the receipt. A receipt made from inputs you gave a server was seen by that server. Each receipt answers one yes/no question; asking many questions about the same figures at different shares reveals more.
output_payload.not_legal_advice: Not legal or regulatory advice. Ability-to-pay determinations require review by the issuer's qualified credit and compliance staff.
